name: Mainak Tourism Property (WBTDC)
summary: The West Bengal Tourism Development Corporation's Siliguri property, formerly Mainak Tourist Lodge, on Hill Cart Road. A plain, dependable transit stay close to the Tenzing Norgay bus terminus, the SNT terminus and the jeep stands.
body: Mainak has been the government's transit lodge in Siliguri for decades, and its location is the main reason to stay: on Hill Cart Road, a short ride from the Tenzing Norgay bus terminus, the SNT terminus for Gangtok buses and the jeep stands for Darjeeling and Kalimpong, and about 6 km from NJP. It suits travellers who arrive late, want an early jeep, or need a night between the hills and the Dooars.

Rooms are standard government-lodge style: clean enough, functional, with attached bathrooms and air-conditioning in the higher categories. There is a restaurant on site. WBTDC renamed its lodges as 'Tourism Properties' a few years ago, so you may see both names. Book through WBTDC's official channels and confirm the category you are paying for.
why: On Hill Cart Road near the bus and jeep terminals
Government-run, with fixed published tariffs
Good value for a one-night transit stop
watch_out: Rooms and service are functional rather than polished, and road noise from Hill Cart Road reaches front-facing rooms.

faqs.q: Is Mainak Tourist Lodge the same as Mainak Tourism Property
faqs.a: Yes. WBTDC renamed many of its lodges as 'Tourism Properties', so Mainak Tourist Lodge on Hill Cart Road in Siliguri is now Mainak Tourism Property. Old guidebooks and drivers may still use the older name.

faqs.q: How far is Mainak from NJP and Bagdogra
faqs.a: Mainak is on Hill Cart Road, about 6 km from NJP and roughly 13–15 km from Bagdogra Airport, 15–40 minutes by car depending on traffic. The Tenzing Norgay bus terminus and the SNT terminus are a short ride away.

faqs.q: How do I book Mainak Siliguri
faqs.a: Book through the West Bengal Tourism Development Corporation's official booking channels or its offices in Kolkata and Siliguri. Rates depend on room category and season, roughly ₹2,000–4,500 per room night, indicative. Check current status before you travel.

name: Murti Banani Eco-Tourism Centre (WBFDC)
rate_band: ₹1,500–4,000 per room or tent night, indicative
summary: The West Bengal Forest Development Corporation's riverside camp at Murti, with 17 cottages of several grades and tents, about 73 km from Siliguri on the edge of Gorumara. Simple, quiet and good value.
body: Murti Banani sits at Uttar Dhupjhora on the bank of the Murti river, on the north-eastern edge of the Gorumara forests. The forest corporation lists standard, deluxe, super deluxe, VIP and premium cottages and tents, with rates from about ₹1,500 for a tent to about ₹4,000 for a premium cottage. Meals are served at the camp at set prices.

The appeal is the location: you walk out of your cottage to the river, hear the forest at night, and are close to the Chandrachur and Medla watchtowers. The corporation's listing mentions birdwatching, jeep safaris, tea gardens and local temples as nearby activities. Facilities are simple, and you should not expect resort service. Book on the corporation's website, especially for winter weekends.
why: On the Murti riverbank at the edge of Gorumara
Wide range of rates, from tents to premium cottages
Close to Medla and Chandrachur watchtowers
watch_out: Weekend picnic crowds on the riverbank can be noisy, and rooms are basic for the higher price bands.

faqs.q: How do I book Murti Banani
faqs.a: Book through the West Bengal Forest Development Corporation website (wbfdc.net), which lists room types and tariffs for its Jalpaiguri properties, or contact its booking line. Book early for October to February weekends. Check current status before you travel.

faqs.q: What are the room types at Murti Banani
faqs.a: The forest corporation lists standard, deluxe, super deluxe, VIP and premium cottages, plus tents, with indicative rates from about ₹1,500 for a tent to about ₹4,000 for a premium cottage per night. Meals are extra and charged per person.

faqs.q: Is Murti Banani good for families
faqs.a: Yes. Children enjoy the riverbank and the forest setting, and the camp is close to watchtowers suited to short attention spans. Keep children away from the river's fast channels and inside the camp after dark, when elephants may pass nearby.

name: Malangi Lodge, Hasimara (WBFDC)
rate_band: ₹2,000–2,700 per room night plus meals, indicative
summary: A forest corporation lodge at Barodabari, Hasimara, next to the Kodalbasti forest of Chilapata. Simple deluxe and super deluxe rooms, set meals, and forest sounds at night; a cheap base for Chilapata and Jaldapara.
body: Malangi Lodge is run by the West Bengal Forest Development Corporation at Barodabari, Hasimara, in the Birpara-Madarihat block of Alipurduar district. The corporation describes it as adjacent to the Kodalbasti forest, the Chilapata side of the Jaldapara landscape. It lists deluxe rooms at about ₹2,000 and super deluxe at about ₹2,700 a night, with meals charged at a fixed daily rate per person.

It suits travellers who want quiet and value rather than facilities. Chilapata safaris start nearby, Madarihat and the Jaldapara counter are 20–30 minutes away, and Hasimara station on the Dooars line is close. Evenings are for sitting outside and listening to the forest; there is little else to do, which is the point.
why: Next to the Kodalbasti forest of Chilapata
Among the lowest rates near Jaldapara
Close to Hasimara station on the Dooars line
watch_out: Facilities are basic, food is set-menu, and you need a car for safaris at Madarihat.

faqs.q: Where is Malangi Lodge
faqs.a: Malangi Lodge is at Barodabari, Hasimara, in Alipurduar district, next to the Kodalbasti forest on the Chilapata side of Jaldapara. Hasimara town and station are close, and Madarihat, the Jaldapara safari base, is 20–30 minutes away by car.

faqs.q: How much does Malangi Lodge cost
faqs.a: The forest corporation lists deluxe rooms at about ₹2,000 and super deluxe at about ₹2,700 per night, with meals charged at roughly ₹500 per person per day, indicative. Rates change; check the WBFDC website before you travel.

faqs.q: Can I do a Jaldapara safari from Malangi Lodge
faqs.a: Yes. Book your Jaldapara or Chilapata safari through the forest department's portal or the Madarihat counter, and arrange a car from the lodge; Madarihat is 20–30 minutes away. Chilapata safaris start closer, on the Kodalbasti side.

name: Aranya Tourism Property, Jaldapara (WBTDC)
summary: WBTDC's lodge at Madarihat, formerly the Jaldapara Tourist Lodge, a short walk from the Jaldapara safari counter. The most convenient government base for rhino safaris.
body: For years this was simply the Jaldapara Tourist Lodge, or the Madarihat Tourist Lodge, and many drivers still call it that. WBTDC now calls it the Aranya Tourism Property. It sits at Madarihat in Alipurduar district, close to the park's main entrance and the safari counter, which matters when your jeep leaves at dawn.

Rooms range from standard to better categories with air-conditioning, and there is a restaurant. The lodge has long been a meeting point for safari jeeps and guides, and staff can help with local arrangements such as trips to Totopara and South Khayerbari. Book through WBTDC's official channels well ahead for winter weekends and holidays.
why: A short walk from the Jaldapara safari counter
Government-run with published tariffs
Good base for Totopara, Khayerbari and Chilapata
watch_out: It is a government lodge: maintenance and service can be uneven, so ask for a renovated room when you book.

faqs.q: Is Jaldapara Tourist Lodge still open
faqs.a: Yes. WBTDC's lodge at Madarihat, formerly the Jaldapara Tourist Lodge, now operates as the Aranya Tourism Property. It is a different building from the Hollong lodge inside the park, which burned down in June 2024. Check current status before you travel.

faqs.q: How far is Aranya Tourism Property from the Jaldapara safari gate
faqs.a: It is at Madarihat, a short walk or a two-minute drive from the safari counter and main entry gate. That makes dawn safaris easy. The South Khayerbari rescue centre is a short drive away.

faqs.q: How do I book the WBTDC lodge at Jaldapara
faqs.a: Book through the West Bengal Tourism Development Corporation's official booking channels or its offices. Rooms sell out for Puja, Christmas and long weekends, so book early. Rates are roughly ₹2,500–6,000 per room night, indicative.

name: The Reserve Gorumara
summary: A 49-room resort on the outskirts of Lataguri, about 3 km from the Gorumara safari gate, with a multi-cuisine restaurant called The Salt Pit. A comfortable mid-range base for families.
body: The Reserve Gorumara is one of the larger private resorts at Lataguri, with 49 rooms on the edge of the town about 3 km from the safari gate and roughly 9 km from the park itself. Rooms are air-conditioned with modern bathrooms, and the property has a restaurant, The Salt Pit, serving Indian and other dishes, plus gardens and family rooms.

It suits families and couples who want hotel comfort after early safaris, and the staff can help with safari bookings and cars. Being a bit away from the highway helps with noise. Rates change sharply with the season; Puja and Christmas weeks are much higher than mid-week stays in February or March.
why: About 3 km from the Gorumara safari gate
Hotel-style rooms and a proper restaurant
Family rooms and garden space
watch_out: Holiday-week rates are high, and like most Lataguri resorts it is busy and less quiet on Puja and Christmas weekends.

faqs.q: How far is The Reserve Gorumara from the safari gate
faqs.a: About 3 km from the Lataguri safari gate and counter, a few minutes by car. Your safari jeep can usually pick you up at the resort; confirm when you book the safari.

faqs.q: Is The Reserve Gorumara good for families
faqs.a: Yes. It has family rooms, a restaurant with a broad menu, and garden space for children. It is a comfortable base after early-morning safaris. Ask for a room away from any event lawns if you want quiet evenings.

faqs.q: Does The Reserve Gorumara arrange safaris
faqs.a: Like most Lataguri resorts, the staff can help arrange forest jeeps and advise on booking. Safari tickets themselves are sold by the forest department, so book your slots on the official portal or check that the resort is buying through the counter.

name: Sinclairs Siliguri
summary: A long-running 48-room hotel in Pradhan Nagar, near Hill Cart Road, with an outdoor pool, restaurant and bar. About 5 km from NJP and 12 km from Bagdogra, it is a comfortable one-night stop.
body: Sinclairs Siliguri is part of the Sinclairs group, which also runs hotels in Darjeeling and the Dooars. It sits in Pradhan Nagar, close to Hill Cart Road and the city's transport hubs, roughly 5 km from NJP and 12 km from Bagdogra Airport. The hotel has 48 rooms over three floors, an outdoor swimming pool, a gym, a multi-cuisine restaurant overlooking the pool and gardens, and a bar.

It is a good choice when you need a quiet, reliable room for one night between flights, trains and jeeps, or a meeting place before a group trip. Buffet breakfast is usually included. Large banquet halls mean weddings and conferences sometimes fill the hotel; ask when booking.
why: Central Pradhan Nagar location near Hill Cart Road
Pool, restaurant and bar for a comfortable transit night
Run by a long-established eastern Himalaya hotel group
watch_out: Wedding and conference events can make the hotel busy and noisy on some evenings.

faqs.q: How far is Sinclairs Siliguri from NJP
faqs.a: About 5 km from New Jalpaiguri station and about 12 km from Bagdogra Airport, 15–40 minutes by car depending on traffic. The Tenzing Norgay bus terminus and the jeep stands on Hill Cart Road are close.

faqs.q: Does Sinclairs Siliguri have a swimming pool
faqs.a: Yes, the hotel has an outdoor swimming pool, along with a gym, a restaurant and a bar. Pool hours and access can change with season and events, so check at check-in.

faqs.q: Is breakfast included at Sinclairs Siliguri
faqs.a: Many room rates include a buffet breakfast, but this depends on the plan and booking channel. Confirm when you book. If you have a very early jeep or flight, ask for a packed breakfast the night before.

name: Mayfair Tea Resort
summary: A large Tudor-style resort set in a working tea garden at New Chumta, between Siliguri and Bagdogra. Pool, spa and several restaurants; the most relaxed place to spend a first or last night on the plains.
body: Mayfair Tea Resort sits in the New Chumta Tea Garden on the edge of Siliguri, between the city and Bagdogra Airport. It is built in a Tudor-inspired style around lawns, with more than 150 rooms, a large outdoor pool overlooking tea bushes, a spa and several dining options. The Mayfair group also runs resorts in Darjeeling, Gangtok and Kalimpong.

This is the place for a soft landing after a long journey or a slow last evening before a flight home. Families like the pool and grounds; couples use it to break a long hill trip. It is not in the hills and not a forest lodge, so choose it for comfort and convenience rather than views. Rates vary widely with season and plan.
why: Set in a tea garden, convenient for Bagdogra Airport
Pool, spa and multiple restaurants
Part of a group with properties across the region
watch_out: It is large and popular for weddings and events, so it can feel busy rather than intimate on peak dates.

faqs.q: How far is Mayfair Tea Resort from Bagdogra Airport
faqs.a: It is between Siliguri and Bagdogra, usually 15–30 minutes by car from the airport depending on traffic. That makes it a convenient first or last night. NJP station is roughly 30–45 minutes away.

faqs.q: Is Mayfair Tea Resort inside a tea garden
faqs.a: Yes. The resort is set in the New Chumta Tea Garden on the edge of Siliguri, and the pool looks over tea bushes. It is on the plains, so expect garden views rather than mountains.

faqs.q: Is Mayfair Tea Resort good for a honeymoon
faqs.a: It works well as a comfortable first or last night of a honeymoon in the hills or the Dooars, with a pool, spa and good dining. For mountain views, pair it with a stay in Darjeeling, Gangtok or Kalimpong.

name: Courtyard by Marriott Siliguri
summary: Siliguri's first international chain hotel, opened in 2019 at Mallaguri on Hill Cart Road. Modern rooms, outdoor pool, spa and restaurants, close to the jeep stands and about 30 minutes from Bagdogra.
body: Courtyard by Marriott opened in Siliguri in 2019 as the brand's first hotel in eastern India outside Kolkata. It stands at Mallaguri on Hill Cart Road in the Pradhan Nagar area, close to the bus terminals and jeep stands, with business-hotel rooms, an outdoor pool, a full-service spa, a fitness centre and restaurants.

It suits travellers who want international-chain consistency for a transit night, Marriott loyalty members, and families who want a pool after a long train or flight. It is a city hotel, not a resort: views are of Siliguri, and the location is chosen for convenience. Book directly or through major platforms.
why: Central Hill Cart Road location near the transport hubs
International-chain standards and loyalty programme
Pool, spa and restaurants for a comfortable stopover
watch_out: It is a city business hotel on a busy road; expect traffic outside and city views rather than greenery.

faqs.q: When did Courtyard by Marriott Siliguri open
faqs.a: It opened in 2019, described at the time as Siliguri's first international chain hotel and the first Courtyard in eastern India outside Kolkata. It is at Mallaguri on Hill Cart Road in Pradhan Nagar.

faqs.q: How far is Courtyard Siliguri from the airport and NJP
faqs.a: Roughly 12–15 km from Bagdogra Airport, 25–40 minutes by car, and 5–7 km from NJP station, 15–25 minutes. The Tenzing Norgay bus terminus and the Hill Cart Road jeep stands are close.

faqs.q: Is Courtyard by Marriott Siliguri good for a one-night stop
faqs.a: Yes. Its location near the jeep stands and bus terminals makes early departures to Darjeeling, Gangtok or the Dooars easy, and the pool and restaurants help after a long journey. Ask for a higher floor to reduce road noise.

name: Sinclairs Retreat Dooars
summary: A 20-acre cottage resort on the hilltop at Chalsa, with 66 rooms and three suites, pools and views over the Dooars forests. The most comfortable base in the western Dooars for Gorumara, Chapramari, Murti and Samsing.
body: Sinclairs Retreat Dooars occupies the top of the Chalsa rise, looking down over the small town, the tea gardens and the forests of Gorumara and Chapramari. Spread over about 20 acres, it has 66 rooms and three suites in cottage-style blocks, each with a balcony, plus an outdoor pool, a children's pool, a steam room, bicycles for guests, a multi-cuisine restaurant and a bar.

Its height gives it something Lataguri resorts lack: cooler evenings, a view, and distance from highway noise. Gorumara's towers, Chapramari and Murti are 15–30 minutes away, Samsing and Rocky Island about an hour. The hotel can arrange safaris and tea-garden visits. Rates vary sharply between peak holiday weeks and quieter months.
why: Hilltop setting with views over the Dooars forests
Pools, cottages and space for families
Central for Gorumara, Chapramari, Murti and Samsing
watch_out: It is spread out on a slope, so expect walks and steps between cottages, reception and the restaurant.

faqs.q: Where is Sinclairs Retreat Dooars
faqs.a: On the hilltop at Chalsa in Jalpaiguri district, overlooking the town and the forests of Gorumara and Chapramari. It is about 75–85 km and two hours from Siliguri, and 15–30 minutes from Lataguri, Murti and the Chapramari tower.

faqs.q: Does Sinclairs Retreat Dooars arrange Gorumara safaris
faqs.a: The hotel can help arrange cars and advise on safari bookings. Tickets are sold by the forest department online and at the Lataguri counter, so it is wise to book your slots early yourself, especially for weekends.

faqs.q: Is Sinclairs Retreat Dooars good for children
faqs.a: Yes. It has a children's pool, open lawns, bicycles and space to run around, and it is close to watchtowers and the Murti river. Note the slopes and steps between buildings if you are travelling with a pram or older relatives.
